description: Countries whose other_renewables generation is geothermal, for labelling copy.
why: OWID publishes no geothermal column. The series we carry as other_renewables is
other_renewable_exc_biofuel_electricity: geothermal plus wave, tidal and some
non-biogenic waste. Naming the source 'geothermal' everywhere would be a guess.
Naming it 'other renewables' everywhere is accurate and tells a reader nothing -
Kenya's page read 'first in the world for other renewables' about a grid that is
So this list is editorial, in the same spirit as blocs.json: it names the grids
where the bucket is geothermal to the point that calling it that is simply true.
A country is only listed when its known geothermal output accounts for the
series, not merely when it owns a plant.
CHE  1.04 TWh, and Switzerland has no geothermal power industry - waste
FRA  0.57 TWh, dominated by the La Rance tidal barrage rather than heat
POL, FIN, NOR, LKA, HUN, MTQ  no meaningful geothermal generation
Japan and Mexico are both real geothermal producers and are absent on purpose:
OWID reports other_renewable_electricity exactly equal to biofuel_electricity
for both, so it publishes no non-biofuel share to label. That is an upstream
gap, not one of ours, and there is nothing in our data to attach a name to.
